newsitem.title: USA: DIGIMEDIA UNIT TO BE SPUN OFF, MERGED.
newsitem.headline: DIGIMEDIA UNIT TO BE SPUN OFF, MERGED.

text.p: DigiMedia USA Inc said on Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement to merge its Interactive Multimedia Training unit with QuickLAB Multimedia Centers Inc, after first spinning off Interactive into a separate company.

The merger will be accomplished by a stock-for-stock exchange, pending U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission approval for the spin-off. The new company is to be called QuickLAB Multimedia Centers Inc. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212 859-1610))
